 ['--bad'],
 ['--sort=colour'],
]
fail=0
for args in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([ref,*args],capture_output=True); p=subprocess.run([exe,*args],capture_output=True)
 ok=(r.returncode==p.returncode and r.stdout==p.stdout and r.stderr==p.stderr)
 print(('OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'), ' '.join(args))
 if not ok:
  fail=1
  print('statuses', r.returncode, p.returncode, 'stdout', len(r.stdout), len(p.stdout), 'stderr', len(r.stderr), len(p.stderr))
  print('REF OUT', r.stdout[:1000].decode('utf-8','replace'))
  print('PY OUT', p.stdout[:1000].decode('utf-8','replace'))
  print('REF ERR', r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
  print('PY ERR', p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
  break
raise SystemExit(fail)
'@ | python -"
